newsitem.title: ITALY: MOTORCYCLING-KOCINSKI CLOSES IN ON FOGARTY.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-KOCINSKI CLOSES IN ON FOGARTY.

text.p: American rider John Kocinski closed in on superbike world championship leader Carl Fogarty of Britain on Sunday after taking his Honda to first and second places in the two races of the fifth round in Italy.
Kocinski, a former top 500cc grand prix racer, finished the day with 163 points, second overall in the world standings behind Ducati rider Fogarty on 177.

Fogarty was unlucky in the first race, in which he finished third after being held up by tail-enders who forced him to brake and allow Kocinski and New Zealand's Aaron Slight to slip through and give Honda a one-two finish.

Italy's Pier-Francesco Chili won the second race on a Ducati, cheered on by the 50,000 fans watching in the rain at the northern Italian circuit. After winning, he hurled his helmet over the fence to his supporters.
American Colin Edwards was the big loser from the weekend, breaking his elbow in a crash in practice on his Yamaha on Saturday. He is likely to be out of action for several months.
The sixth round is at Laguna Seca, California, on July 13.
